This rice plot is small but it feeds my family and brings some money at market, so I must care for it well. I will buy urea and NPK from the agro-dealer when I can — rice does not grow strong here without fertilizer, and I put the cow dung from my compound on it before planting. I got FARO seed last year from a neighbor and it did better than the old seed, so I will use that again, and I will spray herbicide because weeding by hand alone finishes my back. The plot sits near the fadama so I can bring water when the rains stop, and my wife and I will do most of the work but I must hire young men for transplanting and harvest days.
